ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Medicaid funding freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the federal lawsuit over Minnesota's Medicaid funding freeze and its potential impact on the state's healthcare system.
questions: What are the implications of the funding freeze?
How will this affect Minnesota's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: The investigation should focus on the potential consequences of the funding freeze and the arguments presented in the federal lawsuit.

ideas.title: Analysis of childcare fraud legislation
ideas.description: Analyze the new legislation targeting childcare fraud introduced by Rep. Pete Stauber.
questions: What are the key provisions of the legislation?
How will this impact childcare providers and families?
ideas.insight: The analysis should examine the potential effectiveness of the legislation in reducing childcare fraud and its potential impact on the childcare industry.
